findings.detail: Runs kallisto bus with barcode correction on 10x 3'-tag single-cell libraries to produce UTRome isoform and per-cell counts, which is incompatible with the stated bulk transcriptome-to-gene quantification.
Fits pareg regularized regression to gene p-values and pathway similarities, estimating pathway coefficients without computing or testing enrichment at the extremes of a consensus-logFC ranking.
Transforms per-sample expression ranks into GSFM ssGSEA activity scores, which does not test a between-condition consensus-logFC ranking or report the required pathway FDR results.
Runs Trimmomatic in a tumor-normal WES/WGS variant-calling workflow and explicitly excludes RNA-seq inputs, so it does not perform the specified bulk RNA-seq trimming stage.
